column1: # Performance mods for the Prism instance, pinned.
# CLAUDE.md names these four; Fabric API is here because the mod requires it.
# Columns: filename, sha512, url. Tab-separated, # starts a comment.
# Pinned rather than tracked, for the same reason Minecraft is: this is a
# login session, and "it worked yesterday" has to keep meaning something.
# Bumping one is an edit to this file — get the new sha512 from Modrinth's
# API, not from the file you just downloaded, which proves nothing.
# Fabric API is pinned to the version mod/gradle.properties builds against,
# so the mod runs against the API it compiled against.
